desc: We submit herewith the detail of Resignation tendered by Mr. Anil Khandelwal (DIN: 00005619) from the position of Independent Director of the Company with effect from August 24, 2026.

We wish to inform you that Rashi Peripherals Limited ("the Company") has completed the transaction under the Business Transfer Agreement ("BTA") dated August 31, 2026 entered into between Rashi Peripherals Limited ("Seller") and Rashi Semiconductor Solutions Private Limited ("Purchaser").
We write to inform that CRISIL Limited, credit rating agency has reaffirmed its ratings assigned to the credit facilities of Rashi Peripherals Limited.
